tests.title: Install and first launch
tests.acceptance: The exact APK installs and launches without crash; safe areas are visible and execution remains locked.

tests.title: Valid Tailscale pairing
tests.acceptance: Pinned HTTPS pairing succeeds over the private tailnet and no Python token reaches the WebView.

tests.title: Wrong-code rejection and lockout
tests.acceptance: Wrong proofs create no session and the configured failure limit blocks further attempts.

tests.title: Desktop device revocation
tests.acceptance: Revoking the paired device immediately invalidates its current session.

tests.title: Android process restart
tests.acceptance: Because credentials are memory-only, a killed Android process returns to pairing and cannot reuse the prior session.

tests.title: Laptop restart and certificate change
tests.acceptance: A laptop restart invalidates the old session; Android rejects the changed certificate until a new explicit pairing completes.

tests.title: Network loss, sleep, wake, and resume
tests.acceptance: Loss and recovery are visible, bounded, and do not duplicate mutations or bypass reauthentication.

tests.title: Usability and least-privilege scope
tests.acceptance: Status/navigation bars do not cover controls; chart touch works; review scopes work; generation, promotion, MT5 mutation, and every trade route remain blocked.
